author: (Aguayo & Rehder, 1936)

note.en: A small ribbed miter shell about 1.3 cm long from rubble and rocky bottoms. Known here from 1 museum specimen record (Limón, 1929). Depth was not recorded.
note.es: Una concha mitra acostillada pequeña, de unos 1,3 cm, de fondos de escombro y roca. Conocido aquí por 1 registro de ejemplares de museo (Limón, 1929). No se anotó la profundidad.

evidence: GBIF: 1 specimen record in the region (Limón, 1929)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (museum specimens), Gandoca to Limón
